description: React component for the login page of a gym management system, supporting email/password authentication and Google Sign-In via Google Identity Services. Handles user login, token management, and redirection.

methods.name: Login
methods.description: React functional component for user login page, managing form state, Google Sign-In integration, and navigation.

methods.name: handleGoogleCredential
methods.description: Handles Google Sign-In credential response, exchanges token with backend, updates auth tokens, and redirects user.

methods.name: setupGis
methods.description: Initializes Google Identity Services scripts, renders Google Sign-In button, and prompts One Tap.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles email/password login form submission, authenticates user, and redirects.
